title: tillandsia zahnii
intro: Tillandsia zahnii, commonly known as the Zahn's air plant, is a type of epiphyte, a plant that grows on other surfaces without deriving nutrients from them. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate respiratory issues and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Tillandsia zahnii are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, promote relaxation, and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
